scope: One actual complete-flow career, informed baseline with no trades and one optional release; descriptive, not population estimates. Controlled cohorts are separately scoped.

development.note: Checkpoint-to-checkpoint retained players; overall-only UI cannot identify these changed skills. Top-three summary threshold is abs(overall delta)>=2.

foundationDraftOverlap.note: Different worlds may have different clubs, signings, competition and realised careers. Overlap is descriptive, not independent evidence of player boredom.
